Chart.yaml:
apiVersion: v2
name: yeodam-v3-ai-apps
version: 0.1.0
type: application
kubeVersion: ">=1.36.0-0 <1.37.0-0"
files/runtime/prepare-trust.py:
"""Merge public roots only; no application secrets or network calls."""
from pathlib import Path
import ssl
roots=Path('/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt').read_bytes()
for name in ['redis','qdrant','kafka']:
    ca=Path('/etc/yeodam/ca',name+'.crt').read_bytes()
    if b'PRIVATE KEY' in ca:raise SystemExit('Public certificates only')
    roots+=b'\n'+ca
ssl.create_default_context(cadata=roots.decode())
Path('/etc/yeodam/trust/ca-bundle.pem').write_bytes(roots)
files/runtime/start-runner.py:
"""Prepare and report the existing index before exec; never load a GPU model here."""
import os,sys
from pathlib import Path
from app.jobs.config import JobsSettings
from app.infra.place_index import prepare_place_index
cfg=JobsSettings()
path=prepare_place_index(cfg)
if path is None or path.stat().st_size!=1098801152:raise SystemExit('Reference index not ready')
Path('/tmp/place-index-ready').write_text(cfg.PLACE_INDEX_SHA256)
print('Place index ready: bytes=1098801152',flush=True)
os.execv(sys.executable,[sys.executable,'-m','app.jobs.runner'])
